children: Stock index futures were higher on Friday as investors awaited the consumer inflation report, while Oracle posted stronger-than-expected quarterly results and guidance.
Here are the five news items investors should watch:
Diesel prices top $6 amid oil surge:

The national average diesel price climbed to $6.0556 a gallon, according to AAA, marking the first time it has exceeded $6, while California prices neared $8. U.S. crude futures (CL1:COM) topped $100 a barrel Thursday and
gained about 20% this month as fighting between the U.S. and Iran escalated, raising fresh inflation concerns ahead of peak fuel demand.
DeepSeek model pressures Samsung and SK Hynix:
Samsung Electronics
and SK Hynix
fell more than 3% Friday after DeepSeek's latest AI model raised questions about demand for high-bandwidth memory. DeepSeek said it has reduced its models' reliance on the technology, adding
to memory stocks and raising concerns that the sector's recent rebound could face further volatility.
Bessent signals bank sanctions over Iran conflict:

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Trump administration plans to sanction a large bank next week as it increases economic pressure aimed at ending the six-month conflict with Iran. Bessent said the
is planned for Monday but did not identify the bank or its country, leaving investors watching for details on the scope of the measures.
Trump announces $500 Obamacare refunds:

President Donald Trump said nearly 1 million Obamacare enrollees across 30 states will receive $500 refunds beginning in October. The payments will primarily benefit people who do not receive federal premium assistance, including individuals earning more than 400% of the federal poverty level, adding a new policy development for insurers and healthcare investors.
Surgeon general nominee discloses consumer holdings:
President Trump's surgeon general nominee Nicole Saphier disclosed investments in tobacco, restaurant, and beverage companies, including Philip Morris
, Altria
, British American Tobacco
, McDonald's
, and Yum! Brands
, Coca-Cola
, PepsiCo
, and Monster Beverage
. She said she would divest those holdings within 90 days of confirmation and partially divest positions in Bristol-Myers Squibb
, Johnson & Johnson
, and Pfizer
